title: Multiplication without the star operator
prompt: Specification: Return x * y for integers x and y, using recursion and addition rather than the * operator. Four candidate implementations follow. Which candidate satisfies the specification for all valid inputs? Select one candidate.

evidence.title: Candidate executions against the test suite
evidence.body:
Each candidate was executed against the same test suite.

Test 1: assert multiply_int(10,20)==200
Test 2: assert multiply_int(5,10)==50
Test 3: assert multiply_int(4,8)==32
